status.name: Recording status
status.description: Show recording status and compatibility limits.

export_recording.name: Export recording
export_recording.description: Return one recording as JSON. Includes household conversations; administrators only.

list_cases.name: List learning cases

get_case.description: Return the case, grounding evidence, feedback and offline checks.

case_id.name: Case ID
case_id.description: ID returned by List learning cases.

create_case.name: Create learning case
create_case.description: Select a journey from a recording. Leave its destination blank if feedback is needed. Makes no AI requests.

title.name: Title
title.description: A short name for this journey.

first_turn.name: First user turn
first_turn.description: First user turn in this journey, starting at 1.

last_turn.name: Last user turn
last_turn.description: Last user turn in this journey.

intervention_turns.name: Intervention turns
intervention_turns.description: List of correction or clarification turn numbers.

destination.name: Intended outcome
destination.description: What the user wanted to happen.

criteria.name: Command-level criteria
criteria.description: State or transition-sequence criteria. These do not prove physical position.

evidence.name: Grounding evidence
evidence.description: Where the desired outcome and any physical observation came from.

case_feedback.name: Give case feedback
case_feedback.description: Confirm or revise the desired outcome, or mark the request fine as it was. Preserve prior feedback.

case_id.name: Case ID
case_id.description: ID returned by List learning cases.

expected_revision.name: Case revision
expected_revision.description: Current revision from Inspect learning case; prevents overwriting newer feedback.

feedback.name: Your feedback
feedback.description: What should have happened, or what needs correction.

outcome.name: Feedback type
outcome.description: Confirm the destination, request revision, or mark it fine as-is.

destination.name: Intended outcome
destination.description: What the user wanted to happen.

criteria.name: Command-level criteria
criteria.description: State or transition-sequence criteria. These do not prove physical position.

evidence.name: Grounding evidence
evidence.description: Where the desired outcome and any physical observation came from.

audit_case.name: Check recorded actions offline
audit_case.description: Check the recorded tool results and simulated state transitions. This does not run a model or operate devices.

case_id.name: Case ID
case_id.description: ID returned by List learning cases.

prepare_baseline.name: Prepare original-profile baseline
prepare_baseline.description: Inspect the recorded profile, immutable inputs and compatibility before spending. Makes no model requests.

case_id.name: Case ID
case_id.description: ID returned by List learning cases.

start_baseline.name: Start baseline first turn
start_baseline.description: Opt-in paid evaluation of the first original input. Requires the reviewed plan ID. Pauses for response review and never silently resamples a completed attempt.

case_id.name: Case ID
case_id.description: ID returned by List learning cases.

plan_id.name: Reviewed plan ID
plan_id.description: Exact ID returned by Prepare original-profile baseline.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference for this turn
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Sends this original user turn through the existing provider. Normal API charges apply. HA device actions use simulated state; provider-hosted tools retain their original settings.

review_baseline_turn.name: Review baseline response
review_baseline_turn.description: Judge whether this response reproduces the issue and keeps the next original input meaningful. Matching tool calls alone is insufficient. Makes no model requests.

case_id.name: Case ID
case_id.description: ID returned by List learning cases.

expected_turn.name: Expected original turn
expected_turn.description: Next original user-turn number shown by Inspect learning case.

reproduced.name: Response reproduces the relevant behavior
reproduced.description: Off ends the attempt as not reproducible. On allows the next unchanged input, or completes the baseline.

feedback.name: Review evidence
feedback.description: Explain the response match or mismatch, including compatibility with the next original input.

continue_baseline.name: Continue reviewed baseline
continue_baseline.description: Opt-in paid evaluation of the next original input after review. Keeps this trial's generated conversation and native provider history.

case_id.name: Case ID
case_id.description: ID returned by List learning cases.

expected_turn.name: Expected original turn
expected_turn.description: Next original user-turn number shown by Inspect learning case.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference for this turn
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Sends this original user turn through the existing provider. Normal API charges apply. HA device actions use simulated state; provider-hosted tools retain their original settings.

prepare_candidate.name: Prepare script-exposure candidate
prepare_candidate.description: Groups learning cases into one theme and prepares a candidate that exposes existing scripts to Assist. Reads the scripts' current configuration. Makes no model request and changes nothing.

title.name: Theme title
title.description: Short name for the shared problem.

friction.name: Shared friction
friction.description: What made these journeys need extra turns.

evidence.name: Evidence
evidence.description: List of {case_id, role, rationale}. Role is friction, related_success or counterexample.

evaluation_case_id.name: Case to test
evaluation_case_id.description: One friction case with a reproduced baseline; its first original input is replayed.

hypothesis.name: Hypothesis
hypothesis.description: The one change being proposed and why it should help.

scripts.name: Scripts to expose
scripts.description: Existing scripts that were hidden from Assist when the case was recorded.

run_candidate.name: Run candidate
run_candidate.description: Opt-in paid evaluation: replays the case's first original input with the scripts exposed, through the existing provider, once. Scripts and devices are simulated; nothing in the house runs.

plan_id.name: Plan ID
plan_id.description: Exact ID returned by Prepare script-exposure candidate.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Normal API charges apply. One attempt; never resampled.

review_candidate.name: Review candidate result
review_candidate.description: Records a human review of the candidate's reply and expected side effects. Makes no model request.

destination_reached.name: Destination reached
destination_reached.description: The reply and simulated actions reach the case's established destination.

no_regressions_expected.name: No regressions expected
no_regressions_expected.description: The change should not make other known journeys worse.

apply_candidate.name: Accept and apply candidate
apply_candidate.description: Exposes the candidate's scripts to Assist for future use. Never runs a script. Reports already-present settings and conflicts instead of overwriting them.

analyze_recording.name: Analyze recording (journey analyzer)
analyze_recording.description: Opt-in paid evaluation: sends one recording's compact digest to the configured AI Task and returns the journeys it finds, in the label format. One call, never retried. Nothing in the house changes.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Normal API charges apply.

generate_hypotheses.name: Generate hypotheses (hypothesis generator)
generate_hypotheses.description: Opt-in paid evaluation: sends analysed sessions to the configured AI Task, which groups their friction into themes and proposes one change per theme. One call, never retried. Nothing in the house changes.

analyses.name: Analyses
analyses.description: Analysed sessions, as Analyze recording returns them.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Normal API charges apply.

seeded.name: Seeded cases
seeded.description: Optional, for testing the reviewer: named hypotheses it reviews after the generator finishes.

review_hypothesis.name: Review hypothesis (reviewer)
review_hypothesis.description: Opt-in paid evaluation: the configured AI Task keeps, revises or drops one hypothesis and flags likely regressions. One call, never retried. Nothing in the house changes.

hypothesis.name: Hypothesis
hypothesis.description: One hypothesis, as Generate hypotheses returns them.

analyses.name: Analyses
analyses.description: The analysed sessions the review checks against.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Off by default. Normal API charges apply.

check_replay_fidelity.name: Check replay fidelity
check_replay_fidelity.description: Rebuild a recorded conversation's home in a sandbox and compare Assist's system prompt and tools there with the recorded ones. No AI model is called.

test_hypotheses.name: Test hypotheses
test_hypotheses.description: Replay recorded conversations with each hypothesis's changes, on every goal it names, in a sandbox where devices are simulated; up to the tests-per-goal setting for each goal. Can cost money with your AI providers.

analyses.name: Analyses
analyses.description: The journey analyses the hypotheses were built from.

allow_paid_inference.name: Allow paid inference
allow_paid_inference.description: Required: replays call your assistant's AI model.

per_goal.name: Tests per goal
per_goal.description: How many fixes each goal may be tested with, in each conversation where it came up; defaults to the tests-per-goal setting.

init.title: Assist Improver settings
init.description: Assist Improver uses an AI model to analyse your conversations. {guidance} {reason}

data_description.ai_task_entity_id: The improver's own AI roles call this. The recommended option is created with your AI provider's own setup; nothing else changes.
data_description.check_ai_task_entity_id: Optional. A small, cheap model is enough: it checks that the replay's follow-up messages (your recorded words, replayed in order) still fit the replies around them. Leave empty to skip the check.
data_description.tests_per_goal: A multiplier on what your assistant normally costs. A goal can come up in several conversations, phrased differently; each time it came up is tested on its own. Each test replays that conversation with a fix, on your own assistant, so it costs about what the conversation did: with 3, testing costs roughly 3 times those conversations, plus one replay of each original.
